'''Dromund brandy''' was a type of [[Brandy/Legends|brandy]] that shared its name with the [[Dromund system]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], it was a favorite drink of [[Darth Vowrawn]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] on the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dromund brandy was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
